# Bombay Studio — Architectural & Turnkey Interior Design Firm (Mumbai)

> Bombay Studio is a premier architectural and turnkey interior contracting firm headquartered in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India. Led by Principal Architect Ar. Aakhir Choudhary, the studio specializes in luxury residential apartments (2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK), private villas, penthouses, and boutique commercial spaces across Mumbai and Alibaug.

## Core Capabilities
- Architecture: Comprehensive spatial planning, structural design, statutory approvals, and elevation architecture.
- Turnkey Interiors: Full end-to-end design-and-build execution from 3D conceptualization to final site handover.
- Bespoke Joinery & Millwork: In-house factory fabrication using BWP Marine Plywood, anti-termite treatment, and German hardware.
- Project Management (PMC): Milestone-based budgeting, strict on-time delivery guarantees, and direct principal architect site supervision.
- Vastu-Compliant Planning: Scientific spatial alignments for light, airflow, and harmonic living spaces.

## Leadership & Studio Legacy
- Principal Architect: Ar. Aakhir Choudhary
- Studio Origin: Founded in 1992 (originated as Noor Engineering), with over 30 years of civil and interior heritage in Mumbai.
- Track Record: Over 200+ completed residential and commercial projects.
- Operating Geography: Mumbai (Bandra, Juhu, Worli, Powai, Andheri, Kandivali, Mulund, Sewri, Mira Road) and Alibaug.

## Typical Project Typologies
- 2BHK Residences: Turnkey execution from ₹18–25 Lakhs (typical timeline: 60–75 days).
- 3BHK Residences: Turnkey execution from ₹28–45 Lakhs (typical timeline: 90–120 days).
- 4BHK & Penthouses: Bespoke luxury execution from ₹50 Lakhs+ (typical timeline: 120–150 days).
- Commercial & Offices: Turnkey corporate fitouts and boutique spaces.
